script_text: The cosmic currents are shifting, and Mercury Retrograde is pulling the strings of your daily reality. Mercury Retrograde is the infamous planetary backtrack where communication, technology, and travel slow down. Governed by Mercury, the ruler of Air and Earth, this transit forces us to revisit and revise the details of our lives. On August 17, 2026, Mercury Retrograde in your 7th House squares Neptune in the 1st House, bringing confusion to your closest relationships. In love, expect miscommunications and blurred boundaries. In your career, Mercury Retrograde in your 10th House trines Saturn, allowing you to restructure your professional legacy, though financial contracts may experience sudden delays. Karmically, this Retrograde is a mirror for your North Node, asking you to heal old wounds. Chiron's influence highlights where you must speak your truth. Double-check your agreements and back up your digital files. Comment your sign to receive your cosmic guide.
